heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Advisory Council
tree.text: The term “Advisory Council” means the National Advisory Council on Healthcare Research and Quality established under section 299c of this title.

tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “Agency” means the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality.
